prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: weathered layered sandstone cliff / tomb wall with carved horizontal bands
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a wide 2:1 horizontal tileable pixel-art game texture, designed as approximately 256 x 128 underlying art pixels upscaled with nearest-neighbor to approximately 2048 x 1024 display pixels. It depicts ONLY the perfectly straight-on VERTICAL FRONT FACE of a raised ledge in a top-down JRPG map, filling the entire frame edge-to-edge. At the very top, an approximately 6%-height continuous light warm-yellow sandstone rim/lip; beneath, a full-height weathered layered sandstone cliff / ancient tomb wall face with carved horizontal bands, gently darkening toward the bottom; the bottom approximately 8% is a continuous deep reddish-purple dark contact band. Texture details are purposeful chipped stone strata, subtle masonry seams and small eroded crevices in distinctly hand-placed 3-to-10-pixel clusters. Image must be seamlessly tileable horizontally: features, bands, colors and heights crossing the left edge match those entering at the right edge. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art: uniform perfectly crisp square art pixels throughout, sharp hard pixel edges, no antialiasing, no blur, no soft brushwork, no photographic detail, no noise, no checkerboard dithering. Cohesive earthy 4–6-color material ramp: warm yellow highlights and increasingly saturated reddish-purple shaded sandstone toward base. Soft neutral even light from upper left, clean unlit base colors; no cast shadows, nighttime, lamps, glows, vignette, floor, sky, top-down visible upper surface, items, silhouettes, or objects in foreground. Composition is entirely a contiguous wall face texture with horizontal strata and a flat top and bottom edge.
